reviewItem.question: Does "Fixed default retry policy to exclude retries on 503 which is potentially unsafe for idempotent requets" mean a change to protocol-behavior:istio|name=default-retry-policy-503 (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Istio's default retry policy no longer retries on 503; setting EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY to false reverts this, and the flag will be removed in future releases.
